description: Presidential Secretariat - An Essential Public Service for the Life of the Community
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. This constitutes a regulatory action that modifies the legal framework for public services, specifically designating electricity supply and petroleum distribution as essential services. While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather establishes legal/regulatory requirements under existing legislation.
